description: What File Utility can run from an ATLAS Align audit. Kept identical in the ATLAS Align and File Utility repos; a test in each repo checks its copy. A step type definition names one of 'compilers' in its export.fileUtility block, with a status and, for 'partial', the cases it runs in ('when'). 'legacyStepTypes' gives the same answers for definition versions written before that block existed. An action kind names one of 'thenActions' in its export.fileUtility.action; an action with no kind definition (saved before action kinds were definitions) is looked up by its then_action_type. 'operators' and 'blockedOperators' are generated from ATLAS Align's operator catalog by npm run step-types:manifest; don't edit them by hand. 'supported' compiles as is, 'partial' compiles only in the cases named in 'when', anything else is a blocker.

create_column.when: valueModes below; free-text expressions are blockers

join.when: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, UNION; not inside an IF branch

union_sources.when: two different sources; not inside an IF branch

split_field.when: a delimiter is set; not inside an IF branch when it adds rows

values.when: one value per line; a 'blank/null' line means 'or blank'

expression.when: only a run-date token: Today, run date, the run date, report date, run_date

freeform.when: a container for child steps, or the exact text 'DISPLAY "text" in column "name"' or 'Do Not Display'; other text is a blocker

String transformation.when: first_characters, last_characters, character_count, split with a known column count

Expression / calculation.when: expression_type first_characters or character_count, or '<run date> - <field>' / '<field> - <run date>'
